python.reason: Python 3.14 was a future/non-standard requirement. The project runs on modern stable Python versions; >=3.11 aligns with current LTS support and security fixes.

dependencies.reason: Upgrade to latest stable ASGI server with security and performance fixes.

dependencies.reason: pydantic v1 is EOL; v2.12.5 is the latest stable and provides prebuilt wheels for Python 3.14 plus security updates.

dependencies.reason: Required by app/config.py for BaseSettings in pydantic v2. Updated to match pydantic 2.12.x and avoid Rust build issues.
